art_direction.title: Late train home

text:
Late train home
Night, office, the last train. I had a deadline breathing down my neck and the whole sprint on one branch. The platform was empty, the car was still, and my eyes ached from the screen.
Home at one. The city looked honest in the dark.
title: Late train home
